*[[2026–27 NBA season]]
**In [[basketball]], the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] announces that the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] had [[Los Angeles Clippers salary cap scandal|violated]] the [[NBA salary cap|league salary cap]] by signing [[Kawhi Leonard]] in 2022 via a series of external dealings.
